sc: JUST SUE THEM
Customer won't pay? “Just sue them.”
JUST SUE THEM
Easy to say. But how long does that take?
JUST SUE THEM
Forty-one weeks. That's the typical wait for a small claim to reach a trial.
THE WAIT
That's the government's own figure, for April to June this year,
for cases that went all the way to a trial.
THE WAIT
That's over nine months.
Of chasing, waiting, and paying your own bills in the meantime.
THE WAIT
And even if you win, a judgment isn't cash in the bank.
Getting paid can be a whole other step.
THE WAIT
So court isn't a quick cash fix.
WHAT HELPS
Here's what actually helps. One. Know exactly what was agreed.
The signed contract, the payment terms, and proof you delivered.
WHAT HELPS
Two. Send a letter before claim.
Courts expect you to try and sort it out before you go to court.
WHAT HELPS
Three. Expect mediation.
It's now a key step for small claims up to ten thousand pounds.
WHAT HELPS
And the best time to prepare for all this? Before you sign.
